answers.a: As of 27 Oct 2026: Elon Musk said SpaceX has closed $40 billion in debt to buy AI chips arriving in 2027, though Bloomberg reported pricing talks were still under way. answers.q: How often is Musk Systems updated?
answers.a: A new edition is built automatically every day at 07:47 KST (22:47 UTC). This edition was built on 27 Oct 2026 from 17 sources and holds 150 stories, each linked to its original publisher.

answers.q: Is Musk Systems an official Elon Musk website?
answers.a: No. Musk Systems is an independent, unofficial fan tracker. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Elon Musk, SpaceX, Tesla, xAI, X, Neuralink or The Boring Company, and nothing on it is investment advice.
